summary.text: David Wilson is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 105, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Myrtle Beach Realtor, economist and educator who spent more than a decade working in community college systems in South Carolina and North Carolina.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists David Wilson as a graduate of Sol C. Johnson High School with a graduate degree from the University of North Carolina in 2017, and as a real estate professional.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Myrtle Beach and worked for over a decade in the community college systems of both Carolinas, including as a Career Pathway Coordinator designing educational tracks tied to local industries.
He said that work led him to advocate a skills-first model that includes career and technical education, early apprenticeships and vocational training in K-12.
Wilson said his campaign agenda, which he calls RAISE, would establish a state minimum wage, cap property tax increases and cap utility costs.
He also said that his focus for District 105 includes flooding mitigation and local road repair, and that he wants balanced growth rather than developer-driven mega-projects.
